parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main button or actuator of the switch, typically made of durable plastic. It is circular and designed to be pressed by the user.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for toggling the electrical circuit on or off when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or internal mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the housing or enclosure of the switch, typically made of insulating plastic. It supports and protects the internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and insulation for the electrical contacts and the switch mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
